bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; sales and use; providing a refundable exemption for construction materials for certain projects in Cook County schools.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. COOK COUNTY SCHOOLS; SALES TAX EXEMPTION FOR CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS.

Subdivision 1.

Exemption; refund.

(a) Materials and supplies used in and equipment incorporated into the construction, reconstruction, upgrade, expansion, renovation, or remodeling of the following projects at Independent School District No. 166, Cook County, are exempt from sales and use tax imposed under applicable statutes if materials, supplies, and equipment are purchased after May 31, 2025, and before January 1, 2028:

(1) a new secure main entrance, school office area, auxiliary gym, fitness center, activities entrance, and additional locker rooms;

(2) renovations and updates to the main commons area, cafeteria, bathrooms, locker rooms, classrooms, hallways, windows and doors, sidewalks, asphalt, and the outdoor playground area; and

(3) updates to HVAC, lighting, security, and PA systems.

(b) The tax must be imposed and collected as if the rate under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.62, subdivisions 1 and 1a, applied and then refunded in the same manner provided for projects under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.75, subdivision 1, clause (17).

Subd. 2.

Appropriation.

The amount required to pay the refunds under subdivision 1 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective for sales and purchases made after May 31, 2025, and before January 1, 2028.
